DRAFT CONSTITUTION · STEWARDSHIP WITHOUT OWNERSHIP

The institution must be weaker than the archive.

QEVA may curate a canonical release, but it may not own mathematical truth, revoke public history, forbid complete mirrors, or make itself technically necessary for interpretation.

IMMUTABLE COMMITMENTS

Five constraints outrank organizational convenience.

  1. Never silently destroy knowledge.Corrections supersede; refutations remain addressable.
  2. Never hide provenance.Every assertion exposes origin, revision, and qualification state.
  3. Never require QEVA to interpret QEVA.The protocol, schemas, exports, and recovery core remain public.
  4. Anyone may mirror and fork the complete public archive.No permission, account, or special API is required.
  5. Credit remains attached; claims remain challengeable.Attribution is permanent, authority is not.

CHECKS AND ROLES

No single committee controls meaning, infrastructure, and history.

PROTOCOL COUNCIL

Maintains field semantics and compatibility. It cannot rewrite immutable revisions.

EDITORIAL COLLEGIA

Qualify records by mathematical field and publish reasons, dissents, and conflicts.

MIRROR COUNCIL

Independent custodians witness releases, fixity audits, restoration, and succession.

HISTORY COLLEGIUM

Maintains historical claims, uncertainty, regions, traditions, and source disputes separately from proof edges.

RIGHTS STEWARDS

Review licenses and takedown claims without erasing hashes, citations, or the existence of a dispute where lawful.

PUBLIC CHALLENGERS

Anyone can submit a counterexample, competing formalization, provenance correction, or fork.

DECISION RECORD

Every canonical change leaves a trail.

A proposal names exact affected revisions, alternatives, evidence, conflicts, votes or review results, implementation, and appeal route. Emergency actions expire unless ratified in public.

proposal → public review → qualified decision → new revision/release
                  ↘ published dissent ↗

No vote can make a theorem true.
No theorem can decide a license.
No maintainer can erase an exact public revision.

SUCCESSION TRIGGER

If the steward fails, the mirrors choose continuity.

After a declared period with no valid release, no reachable officers, or material constitutional breach, independent mirrors may publish a witnessed successor branch. The old namespace and revision history remain intact.

  • Archive ownershipPUBLIC COMMONS
  • Canonical stewardshipCONDITIONAL
  • Mirror permissionIRREVOCABLE
  • Dissent recordPRESERVED
  • SuccessionTESTABLE
